verified: Main screen zones, depth decimals, ascent arrows, NDL colours (Rec manual Rev C p.12-13)
Safety stop and deco stop badges: titles, check mark before the value, arrows, Complete (p.27-28)
Notification row: Warning / Alert, Confirm, yellow message (p.22, p.25-26)
Tank pressure on a yellow / red box below the reserve / critical pressure (p.40, p.57)
Tec page row rules: whole minutes, CLEAR counter (Petrel 3 Technical manual Rev B p.24-25)

Info pages: the main screen with its bottom row replaced by one info screen - AI (T1 & GTR/SAC, and T1, T2 & GTR/SAC on a sidemount dive), MOD / MAX / PPO2, TEMP / CONSERV / CNS, GF99 / SurGF / CEIL, BATTERY, PRESSURE mBar SURF / NOW, DATE / CLOCK (Perdix 2 Rec manual Rev C p.16 (row figure), p.17-21)
Gauge page: large depth and dive time, MAX / STOPWATCH, AVG, temperature, clock (Perdix 2 Rec manual Rev C p.34)
assumed: Deco Clear counter look on the main page (green CLEAR, m:ss): no figure in the recreational manual
Notices stay 10 s: the device keeps them until a button press

CC page: the Perdix 2's CC/BO mode is in its Technical Modes manual, which is not on hand - drawn as the Petrel 3's internal-setpoint screen (Technical manual Rev B p.10: the setpoint in the centre position, no title; CC / BO label, BO yellow, p.14), PPO2 there on a bailout as the Perdix 3 shows it
Info and gauge positions measured from the manual's figures and set on the main page's skin
Gauge STOPWATCH shows the dive time: a log records no stopwatch start or reset
Info screens are shown in full, without the 10 s timeout; the date and clock are the log's own time (24 h)
not_shown: Persistent notifications left of the NDL (MOD, Near MOD, Better Gas, High CNS; p.23)
Info screens LAST DIVE (surface only), Compass (no heading in a log), TISSUES, DET / Δ+5 / @+5 / TTS (what-if values not computed), SERIAL NO / VERSION
CONSERV level name (Low / Med / High) above the GF pair, and the battery type / nominal voltage beside BATTERY: not in the logs
Gauge page: no notification row and no resettable average (deco is not tracked in gauge mode)
notes._about: What this template reproduces of the real screen and what it does not; manual pages in hud_rules_sources.md
